name: Keo Siu Chau
summary: Kẹo Sìu Châu is a peanut and sesame candy. VnExpress cooks peanuts, sesame, sugar, and malt, and ties the name to an old candy shop at bến sông Vị Hoàng. Dân trí says this candy uses more peanut and less malt than ordinary kẹo lạc, so it is more fragrant, crisp, and not sticky on the teeth. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Nam Định. The Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018 and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 name it as a gift. VnExpress, 18 March 2016, and Dân trí, 4 March 2017, describe it. Báo Nam Định lists it as an OCOP product and a city gift.
texture: Dân trí: crisp, nutty, lightly sweet, not sticky on the teeth. VnExpress: the hot mass is poured onto a tray dusted with sticky-rice flour, rolled thin, and cut into bite-size pieces.
howToEat: As a piece to carry. Dân trí and Thế giới tiếp thị say it is especially eaten at Tết, with a cup of hot tea. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: The city. VnExpress names bến sông Vị Hoàng as where the name began, not as a door to visit. A factory address was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Keo Siu Chau — peanut candy from Nam Dinh
seoDescription: Peanut and sesame candy, crisper and less malty than ordinary kẹo lạc on Dân trí’s account. Eat it with hot tea. A price is Check on arrival.
